questions.question: Are application security requirements defined and enforced prior to production, and is every decision the system makes logged for post-hoc review?
Is an independent, third-party audit or certification (e.g. SOC 2, ISO 27001) currently held?
questions.evidence_ref: CLAUDE.md status notes: no ISO/IEC 42001 or PCI DSS certification/assessment has been undergone as of this writing

questions.question: Is there a documented, tested disaster-recovery / business-continuity plan?
questions.evidence_ref: actaseal/ops/backup.py provides ledger backup/restore primitives; a formal, tested BCP/DR runbook covering RTO/RPO commitments does not yet exist -- honest gap, not fabricated

questions.question: Are policy/config changes version-controlled with maker-checker separation?
questions.evidence_ref: actaseal policy lifecycle (maker-checker versioning); actaseal/api/rbac.py PERM_MANAGE_POLICIES vs PERM_VIEW_POLICIES split

questions.question: Can a data subject's personal data be erased on request without destroying the audit trail's integrity?
Describe physical datacenter access controls for the systems hosting this service.
questions.evidence_ref: ActaSeal is software deployed into the buyer's own infrastructure/cloud account; it has no ActaSeal-operated physical datacenter -- physical security is the buyer's (or their cloud provider's) responsibility

questions.question: Does the vendor ever hold the production signing/encryption key on the vendor's own systems?
questions.evidence_ref: actaseal/signing.py module docstring: 'ActaSeal never holds the production key' -- LocalDevSigner refuses construction under LIVE_ENFORCEMENT (SELF_CUSTODY_FORBIDDEN); production signs through an external ReceiptSigner (buyer's KMS/HSM)

questions.question: Can historical records still be verified after a signing key is rotated?
questions.evidence_ref: actaseal/signing.py ReceiptKeyRing / KeyRegistry (key_id-scoped verification, rotation never deletes an old entry)

questions.question: Is there a documented policy-authorship and approval workflow, itself logged?
Describe vendor employee background-check and security-training programs.
questions.evidence_ref: Not a control this codebase implements or can attest to -- an organizational HR policy question, out of scope for a product-level questionnaire pre-fill; a human must answer this from the vendor's actual HR practice, not invent one here

questions.question: Is role-based access control enforced on every write path, distinct from read access?
questions.evidence_ref: actaseal/api/rbac.py (PERM_MANAGE_POLICIES vs PERM_VIEW_POLICIES; CLAUDE.md TODO entry documents when this split was added and why)

questions.question: Is API request volume rate-limited?
questions.evidence_ref: actaseal/api/rate_limit.py (global middleware); CLAUDE.md known-bugs note on its per-process, in-memory-counter limitation (not yet a shared/global store across multiple instances)

questions.question: Can audit records be exported in a standard, tool-independent format for a buyer's own tooling?
Does the product ship a native mobile application?
questions.evidence_ref: ActaSeal is a server-side policy gateway with a browser console; no native mobile client exists

questions.domain: Security Incident Management, E-Discovery & Cloud Forensics
questions.question: Are anomalous/out-of-scope actions given a durable, reviewable incident record distinct from a live-only alert?
questions.evidence_ref: docs/actaseal/standards-traceability.md#nist-ai-rmf (MANAGE 4.x row); BREACH-case console view, ScopeEvaluated ledger events

questions.question: Are third-party inputs to a decision themselves provenance-tagged rather than trusted implicitly?
Has the offline/packet verifier been tested against adversarial inputs (zip-slip, JSON bombs, malformed packets)?
